name: image
title: Image
description: A picture in a box that keeps its shape while it loads, with a fallback when it cannot load.

when: A product photo, a cover, a thumbnail in a card.

instead.when: The picture is of a person or a company.
A picture to open full screen.

guidance.rule: Give `ratio` so the page does not jump while the picture loads.

builtIn: The fallback keeps the alt text as its name.
youProvide: An alt text that says what the picture shows, or "" for decoration.
